text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Gotta be Fuji Kiseki today! Her NHK Mile 
Cup was such a great race, too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, but there's still Biko Pegasus 
and Hishi Akebono, right? Those girls are 
tough."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"True. She's usually all bubbly, but today 
she really seems dialed in..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While various conversations buzzed about, 
back in the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! I suppose even I'm feeling a 
little nervous.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-senpai! I'm looking forward to 
working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Biko! Thanks for going out of your 
way. I'm looking forward to working with 
you too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Heroes always have proper manners!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Akebono too? Fufu, it's gotten quite 
lively around here!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, hello, Fuji-san~. Biko-chan, let's 
do our "Ei-ei-oh!" soon!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Right, right~. Today is an important race, 
so we promised to get each other pumped 
up~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I know! Fuji-san, you join in too! I'm 
sure it'll be super fun~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Today is a battle for everyone, 
after all~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, ahaha! You're right, thank you. 
That helped ease my nerves.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Once again, I'm counting on both of you 
today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the three's spirited 'Ei-ei-oh!' echoed 
through the waiting room— the Mile 
Championship got underway!
